$comment: Phase 11 brief D8: the detector models the voice child loads, pinned by sha256. The shared entries (melspectrogram, embedding, keyword, vad) must equal frontend/src/lib/voice/model-manifest.json (tests/test_models.py), so the browser and the node run the same wake model. smart_turn ships inside the pinned pipecat-ai wheel and is verified against this hash before loading. The child refuses to arm wake mode unless every wake file's sha256 matches; an empty sha256 means 'not pinned yet' and always refuses. Files live outside the repo, in the node's model directory.
